reachableBeatOrder.terminalSemantics: ch10-* is ordered BEFORE 'done' in the array, but is entered by re-activation OUT of 'done' free play. beats/ch10/ch10-cold.ts declares entry: 'reactivation-from-done'; beats/registry.ts::chapterReactivationBeat resolves it. hasCompletedStory() keys on 'story:ch9:hearth'. storyEntryPoint() reads ch10 rungs BEFORE the ch9Hearth two-world terminal, so a ch10-in-progress save resumes inside ch10 and a ch10-complete save returns to 'done'.

publicReleaseCeiling.corroboration: CLAUDE.md 'Story scope': post-arrival build authorized 2026-07-28; demo release surface unchanged at ch4-arrival; shipping past it is not implied.

sidecarStationAndReturnChronology.authorityForm: R12 post-terminal sidecar (.codex/production-runs/2026-08-11-ch10-station-introduction/station-continuation-contract.md). The ch11/ch12 milestone namespace reserves the intended chronology; the slice claims NO new StoryState beats and NO signed chapter-registry entry. Player-facing header is 'STATION VISIT', not 'CHAPTER 11'.

additionalGates: address must equal storyStationAddress() (first station of the STORY_COORDINATE system manifest)
entryGate.note: Standalone ?spacestation= remains a noncanonical ephemeral sandbox; the station page is a SEPARATE Vite/React entry and cannot borrow the live Story director or App boot persistence.

stationStepMachine.derivation: complete if ch11-station-departed; depart if ch11-bonded-cell-acquired AND itemCount(bonded_cell)>0; issuer if ch11-registry-recorded; else registry. Derived from durable facts only, so reload rebuilds the same step.

commitOrderingConstraints.issueBondedCell: refused unless habitat fault presented; adds bonded_cell only if count===0; also marks story:station-trade-unlocked

persistence.store: same inventory/progression stores as the main game (game/systems/inventorySystem.ts, progressionSystem.ts, persistence.ts)
persistence.reconciliation: reconcileStationStoryCargo() repairs interrupted partial writes only: receipt-without-item re-adds one item; item-without-receipt marks acquired ONLY if registry recorded; never creates a second item.
persistence.saveSeam: persistStationStory() re-saves via createPlanetIdentity(parsePlanetWorldId(lastPlanetWorldId)) so the exact companion-planet identity (e.g. '-1,-1:p1') is what App resumes on undock, not the collapsed system coordinate.

returnChronology.pendingPredicate: stationReturnPending() = ch11-station-departed AND ch11-bonded-cell-acquired AND NOT ch12-bonded-cell-installed AND itemCount('bonded_cell')>0
objectiveStates: station:return:tidegarden (travel) while not on TIDEGARDEN_WORLD_ID surface — marker projects 'spatial' onto the companion body target
hearth:return:install-cell (interact) when activePlanetId===TIDEGARDEN_WORLD_ID AND flight.phase==='surface' AND controlMode!=='flight' — marker projects 'surface' onto habitat.core.position
returnChronology.installGuards: installTidegardenBondedCell refuses on wrong world, missing habitat, distance > STATION_RETURN_INSTALL_REACH (4.2), or missing cell; consumes exactly one bonded_cell; marks ch12-bonded-cell-installed AND ch12-hearth-restored; idempotent second call returns {ok:true, changed:false}
returnChronology.worldInteraction: main/src/story/world/TidegardenSettlementWorld.tsx registers interaction id 'story-ch12-install-bonded-cell', verb 'Install the Sealed Bonded Cell', and saveGlobal() on change
returnChronology.interactionPriority: storyInteractions.ts: 'story-ch12-install-bonded-cell' = { interactionClass: 'required', priority: 560 } — the highest story priority in the table (ch10 bearing claim is 520)

exactCurrentSourcePaths.textChannels: main/src/story/storyText.ts (caption/system/workorder/auditLine/violations store only — owns no copy)
exactCurrentSourcePaths.modularizationNote: Story is modularized: beats/ owns per-beat contracts, journeys, markers, input policy, rails; autopilot/ owns steering primitives. The legacy giant files no longer own all text — storyScript.ts stops at ARRIVAL_LINES (ch4-arrival) and emergentStoryDirector.ts owns everything from ch4-audit onward.
